origin.heading: How this started
origin.body: We began by building software for our own problems: a school that needed fees recorded, a fabrication shop losing track of jobs, students who could not afford a tutor. Each one shipped, and each one still runs. Client work followed, because the fastest way to prove you can build something is to point at something you built.
